evals.prompt:
You are acting as the harness-planner node in a Harness Pipeline. Execute the harness-planner skill with this task context:

TASK_ID: eval-planner-001
SPRINT_DIR: /tmp/sprint-eval-planner-001
thin_prd: 'playground 加 GET /ping 路由，返回 JSON: {pong: true, ts: <unix timestamp>}'
task_title: '测试演练 B42'

IMPORTANT: this is a dry-run eval. Instead of pushing to git, write sprint-prd.md to SPRINT_DIR and output your final verdict JSON. Also note: the Brain API is unavailable, skip the curl step. Focus on producing the correct sprint-prd.md content.

Save sprint-prd.md to /tmp/sprint-eval-planner-001/sprint-prd.md
Also save a transcript of your work to /tmp/sprint-eval-planner-001/transcript.md

assertions.text: topic-lock: sprint-prd.md contains '/ping' keyword from thin_prd (not renamed to /health or /status)
no-task-title-pollution: sprint-prd.md topic is NOT 'B42' or '测试演练'
